ideas.pitch: A real-time analytics dashboard that ingests chat transcripts, tracks the emotional arc across multi-turn exchanges, and flags subtle shifts into sarcasm, passive-aggression, and escalation.
ideas.title: ChatPulse: Multi-Turn Conversation Emotional Arc & Sarcasm Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Problem Statement PS-01 for the Cerebro Hackathon, addressing the exact requirements of sarcasm detection and emotion-arc visualization over conversations.

ideas.pitch: An NLP pipeline that monitors live customer support chats, calculates rolling sentiment and toxicity metrics, and predicts customer churn or escalation risk before it happens.
ideas.title: EscalationEye: Customer Support Sentiment Escalation Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages time-series forecasting and regression patterns seen in winning AI incident models, applied specifically to conversational emotion tracking.

ideas.pitch: A graph-based sentiment visualization tool that maps interpersonal relationships, hidden tensions, and shifting tone dynamics across group messaging platforms.
ideas.title: ToneGraph: Network Analysis of Group Chat Dynamics and Tensions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines graph intelligence with affective computing, providing the technical depth judges look for in CSE department hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension and API that highlights ironic or passive-aggressive remarks in long Slack or Discord chat logs with confidence scores.
ideas.title: SarcasmScope: Fine-Tuned Irony Detector for Multi-Turn Dialogues
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the notoriously difficult NLP problem of sarcasm and irony detection requested in PS-01 with a functional, end-to-end usable product.

ideas.pitch: An automated auditing tool that ingests customer success chat histories, visualizes the emotional trajectory, and generates executive summaries of team-to-customer emotional resonance.
ideas.title: EmpathChat: Executive Summary of Conversational Emotional Health
ideas.why_it_could_win: Translates complex affective computing metrics into clear, actionable business insights that appeal directly to academic and industry judges.
